services.desc: Ready to experience the best of Puget Sound salmon fishing? Ruby D Charters is a father-and-son team based in the Seattle area, committed to helping anglers of all skill levels land the salmon of a lifetime. Whether you’re new to fishing or a seasoned pro, our private salmon fishing charters are designed to deliver an unforgettable adventure on the water. Salmon fishing in the Pacific Northwest kicks off on April 2nd and runs through mid-October, making this the perfect time to plan your guided trip. Our 2026 booking calendar is now live!
